notes: Verbatim import (Stage 73). The RFC prints password/salt/secret/associatedData/preHashingDigest/tag as space-separated hex byte rows; this file concatenates each field into one lowercase hex string, byte-length-checked against the RFC's own stated field sizes ([32]/[16]/[8]/[12] octets, 64-octet pre-hashing digest, 32-byte tag). The RFC's intermediate 'After pass 0/1/2' block dumps are themselves abbreviated in the source with '...' (only the first 4 and last 4 64-bit words of specific blocks are printed) — they are NOT full internal-state vectors and are reproduced here only as free-text 'notes', not as a byte field, since the RFC itself does not give their complete bytes. This is the ONLY test vector RFC 9106 §5.3 publishes for Argon2id (m=32 KiB, t=3, p=4 is a small, fast-to-verify parameter set chosen by the RFC's authors for conformance testing — it is NOT a production parameter recommendation; see docs/crypto_vector_sources.md §7 on the separate future mobile/desktop production-parameter decision). RFC 9106 does not publish a byte-level tamper/negative Argon2id vector; per the verbatim-only rule, none is fabricated here. No Rust code reads this file yet.

vectors.description: RFC 9106 §5.3 sole published Argon2id conformance test vector.
vectors.notes: password/salt/secret/associatedData are the RFC's fixed, non-secret conformance-test byte patterns (repeated 0x01/0x02/0x03/0x04 respectively) — never real passphrase material, per docs/crypto_test_vectors.md §6. preHashingDigestH0 is Argon2's internal BLAKE2b-512 pre-hash (64 bytes), included because the RFC prints it explicitly as an intermediate checkpoint. The RFC's 'After pass 0/1/2' internal block dumps are abbreviated (first/last 4 words of specific blocks only, separated by '...') and are not reproduced as data here — only 'tag' (the final 32-byte output) is a complete, verifiable known-answer value.
